name: Memory Fusion
description: Owns the memory slot and searches every enabled OpenClaw memory plugin at once, merging results by rank.

rrfK.description: Reciprocal rank fusion constant. Larger values flatten the gap between ranks. Default 60.

weights.description: Rank weight per backend plugin id (default 1). 0 drops a backend from results.

timeoutMs.description: Per-backend deadline for search, get and candidates calls, in milliseconds. Default 15000.

store.description: Where new memories go. "auto" (default): every backend that accepts writes, or the workspace memory files (memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md, indexed by memory-core) when none does. "all": every writable backend plus the workspace. Or a list of backend plugin ids and/or "workspace".
